The Active Network is an American software company in event registration and participation
management. It appears in this register for one reason: since 2008 it has owned
[Hy-Tek Sports Software](hy-tek.md), whose programs run most competitive swimming meets in
the United States.[^active08]

Active announced the purchase on 8 July 2008, buying Hodgson's Hurricanes, Inc. and certain
assets of T&C Products, Inc., the two entities trading together as HY-TEK Sports Software.
Terms were not disclosed. The release listed team and meet management, athlete training and
performance software, administrative tracking, a web-based Team Manager Online and products
for Palm OS handhelds among what changed hands.[^active08] Active describes the Hy-Tek
branded products as owned, copyrighted and supported by it.[^hytekabout]

It also owns [Meet Mobile](../software/meet-mobile.md), the live-results application that
publishes what Meet Manager scores, which it acquired separately.[^meetmobile]

Active makes no aquatics equipment and is not otherwise covered here.
